// dir: x
// want: analyzer "file-size" declares "max_lines", nothing reads it
// want: x run: key is not a constant
// with: pass
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/pass"

func run(params pass.ParamSet, ctx pass.Context) {
	key := "max_lines"
	if ctx == (pass.Context{}) {
		key = "ghost"
	}
	params.Int(key, 1)
}
